decisions.label: Nucleus
decisions.description: A body within the cell, surrounded by a membrane, within which lie the chromosomes, one or more nucleoli, combined with proteins, and exhibits mitosis.

verification.note: NCIT:C13197 Nucleus; exact label match for the cell nucleus as an imaging segment object class.

decisions.label: Cytoplasm
decisions.description: The protoplasm of a cell outside the nucleus, bounded by the plasma membrane and containing all of the cell's organelles except the nucleus.

verification.note: NCIT:C13226 Cytoplasm; exact label match for the cytoplasm as an imaging segment object class.

decisions.label: Plasma Membrane
decisions.description: The semipermeable membrane that encloses the cytoplasm of a cell.

verification.note: NCIT:C13735 Plasma Membrane; exact label match.

decisions.label: Cell
decisions.description: The smallest units of living structure capable of independent existence, composed of a membrane-enclosed mass of protoplasm and containing a nucleus or nucleoid.

verification.note: NCIT:C12508 Cell; 'Whole Cell' as an imaging object class means the entire cell is the segmentation target. NCIT:C12508 'Cell' is the correct concept; label adds 'Whole' qualifier not reflected in the NCIT term.

decisions.label: Other
decisions.description: Different than the one(s) previously specified or mentioned.

verification.note: NCIT:C17649 Other; standard NCIT general qualifier, exact label match.
